theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Taiwan Dethrones Korea Atop Global Markets as AI Trade Widens
top_news.summary: As equity investors enter the final stretch of a pivotal year that’s propelled South Korea and Taiwan to the forefront of the global AI trade, the latter is emerging as the stronger bet.

top_news.title: Asset Management One to Boost Talent Spending 30% Over 3 Years
top_news.summary: Asset Management One Co. plans to boost spending on talent over the next three years as rising Japanese interest rates broaden investment choices and push pension funds, university endowments and individuals to rethink how they allocate their money.

top_news.title: BHP Sells Shuttered Australian Nickel Plant to Gold Fields
top_news.summary: BHP Group will sell its Kambalda nickel concentrator plant and associated land in Western Australia to Gold Fields Ltd. for an undisclosed price.

top_news.title: Ken Leech Agrees to $3 Million SEC Fine Over Cherry-Picking Case
top_news.summary: Ken Leech, the former co-chief investment officer at Western Asset Management Co., agreed to pay $3 million to settle a US Securities and Exchange Commission lawsuit claiming he’d cherry picked winning trades.

top_news.title: BofA Team Touts Options for Tech Sector to Hedge Bubble Risk
top_news.summary: Investors wary of owning technology megacaps can tap equity derivatives both to benefit from the record rally and protect against the fallout from a potential bubble, according to strategists at Bank of America Corp.

top_news.title: Surging Yields Hit Asian Bond Sales as AI Fundraising Trails US
top_news.summary: Borrowers in the Asia Pacific are slowing deals in the dollar bond market, with the highest yields in more than two years sapping deal momentum.

top_news.title: Why Gas Flares Keep Burning Despite Big Oil’s 2030 Pledges
top_news.summary: Residents in West Texas describe noise, odors and health concerns from a gas flare operating near their homes as oil producers face scrutiny over pollution and their commitments to curb emissions. Oil giants including ExxonMobil, Occidental Petroleum and others have pledged to reduce or eliminate the flaring practice, but a new investigation by Bloomberg News and The Examination found persistent flames at sites tied to companies participating in the World Bank’s Zero Routine Flaring initiative.

top_news.title: Hamilton Lane’s Bell on Secondary Markets Opportunity
top_news.summary: As U.S. mortgage rates rise above 7% for the first time in a couple of years, Elizabeth Bell, Co-Head of Real Estate at Hamilton Lane, discusses whether the broader real estate market has been written off amid a slow post-pandemic recovery, changing consumer spending and higher rates. Bell says the market faces risks from elevated interest rates and geopolitics, which weigh on investment and yields, but still offers opportunities. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." top_news.title: Apollo Weighs Larger Role in Government Lending as Debt Soars
top_news.summary: Apollo Global Management is scoping out a bigger role in financing debt-laden governments and state-backed companies as they increasingly turn to private capital to plug budget gaps.
